requirements.research_statement: Yandex Search API provides synchronous generative search based on relevant Yandex search results; when site/host/url scope is omitted, search runs across the Yandex search index.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Run official GenSearch on each exact Step-15 authoritative query with no provider scope restriction.
requirements.cost_or_quota_boundary: 5.08 RUB estimated per synchronous generative request; sequential execution
requirements.failure_policy: If provider result is unavailable/unknown, apply the governed retry rule; otherwise preserve exact response.
requirements.claim_boundary: GenSearch observation is not consumer Alice output.
requirements.qa_check: 8/8 planned exact query strings equal STEP_15_SELECTED_CASES_V2.tsv authoritative_query values.
requirements.acceptance_check: Every selected case has an accounted initial observation state.

requirements.research_statement: The response can expose message, sources with url/title/used, refined searchQueries with text/reqId, fixed misspell query and answer-status fields.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Preserve the complete returned response fields without representative-only truncation.
requirements.required_artifact_field_or_output: message; sources[]; searchQueries[]; fixedMisspellQuery; isAnswerRejected; isBulletAnswer; hints[]; problematicAnswer
requirements.failure_policy: Missing optional fields are preserved as missing/empty, not fabricated.
requirements.claim_boundary: Only returned provider-native fields are provider facts; orientation summary is analyst interpretation.
requirements.qa_check: Raw saved field counts and values reconcile with delivered Bridge result.
requirements.acceptance_check: No useful result is accepted from a summary-only copy.

requirements.research_statement: GenSearch response fields are not all required; no relevant documents or extraction uncertainty can produce sparse or non-discriminative responses.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Allow an explicit INSUFFICIENT evidence state when the returned evidence cannot discriminate the pre-registered decision boundary.
requirements.cost_or_quota_boundary: Governed no-usable-result retries may add cost.
requirements.failure_policy: Never force CHANGE/NO_CHANGE from a non-discriminative successful response.
requirements.claim_boundary: Provider success does not imply analytical sufficiency.
requirements.qa_check: Every INSUFFICIENT result has explicit evidence-grounded reason.
requirements.acceptance_check: No sparse response is coerced into a stronger outcome.

requirements.research_statement: The API documents a used boolean for sources but no ordinal source-ranking semantics.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Preserve source array order raw, but analyze only source identity, role/specificity and used=true/false where supported.
requirements.failure_policy: If role cannot be supported from URL/title/current known page role, set SOURCE_ROLE_UNRESOLVED.
requirements.claim_boundary: sources[] order is not represented as ranking, importance score or consumer-visible citation order.
requirements.acceptance_check: All source conclusions are role-based, not order-based.

requirements.research_statement: Published quota is one generative response request per second and 1000 per hour; request limit is 400 characters and 40 words.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Execute one command at a time, with persistence/readback between paid interactions.
requirements.claim_boundary: Quota compliance does not prove evidence completeness.
requirements.qa_check: No overlapping paid Step-16 GenSearch interactions.
requirements.acceptance_check: All provider actions are sequential and individually reconciled.

requirements.research_statement: Current RUB price is 5080 RUB per 1000 synchronous requests with generative response, equivalent to 5.08 RUB per request.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Account every executed initial, retry and confirmation provider request separately.
requirements.cost_or_quota_boundary: initial 8 = 40.64 RUB; each additional billable call = 5.08 RUB
requirements.failure_policy: Do not hide retry or confirmation cost inside base count.
requirements.claim_boundary: Cost is estimated/reconciled from current provider tariff and execution truth.
requirements.qa_check: provider_cost_rub reconciles to executed billable request count and recorded exceptions.
requirements.acceptance_check: Cost accounting complete before Step 17 handoff.

requirements.research_statement: Owned Alice-AI visibility is a Webmaster tool requiring site rights; it is a distinct first-party surface with recent rolling data.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Do not execute owned Webmaster Alice evidence for OKNO_MSK because access is unavailable; record the route explicitly as unavailable.
requirements.failure_policy: Base Step 16 continues through official GenSearch.
requirements.claim_boundary: No owned Alice visibility/SoV/history claim is permitted for OKNO_MSK.
requirements.qa_check: No private-Alice evidence is cited as observed.
requirements.acceptance_check: Optional enhancement is explicitly accounted, not silently skipped.

requirements.research_statement: Yandex explicitly states that consumer Alice AI creates new answers from current search evidence and answer/source composition for the same query can differ over time.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Use this only as context supporting caution around one generative snapshot; do not claim it proves exact GenSearch temporal behavior.
requirements.failure_policy: If cited, label consumer Alice and GenSearch as distinct surfaces.
requirements.claim_boundary: Consumer-Alice variability evidence is not direct GenSearch equivalence evidence.
requirements.qa_check: No consumer-Alice statement is relabeled as GenSearch-native behavior.

requirements.research_statement: AI evaluation should document test conditions, uncertainty and reliability; Step 15 separately requires confirmation before a material AI delta changes architecture.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: For an initial CHANGE_CANDIDATE or CONTROL_BREAK_CANDIDATE, obtain one additional same-query GenSearch observation if the owner authorizes the conditional confirmation branch.
requirements.cost_or_quota_boundary: +5.08 RUB per confirmed case; max 8 conditional confirmations in current selected set
requirements.failure_policy: If confirmation is inconsistent/non-discriminative, final state is MATERIAL_DELTA_NOT_REPRODUCED / INSUFFICIENT_FOR_ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE.
requirements.claim_boundary: One confirmation is a project-specific bounded risk control, not a statistical standard and not proof of long-term stability.
requirements.acceptance_check: Step 17 receives no unconfirmed architecture-changing AI delta.

requirements.research_statement: Exactly eight V2 cases are authorized as the Step-16 candidate input universe; V1 must not feed Step 16.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Use exact V2 case IDs and authoritative_query strings without manual reconstruction/paraphrase.
requirements.required_artifact_field_or_output: case_id + exact authoritative_query + V2 lineage reference
requirements.failure_policy: Any query/case mismatch blocks execution for that case and subsequent provider action until repaired.
requirements.claim_boundary: Selected set is diagnostic with controls, not representative.
requirements.acceptance_check: No silent case drops or substitutions.

requirements.research_statement: Project validation established GenSearch as a useful structured AI-search surface but explicitly forbids exact consumer-Alice equivalence and preserves searchQueries as GenSearch-only provenance.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Use GEN_SEARCH_* provenance labels and preserve current Bridge runtime/version metadata.
requirements.failure_policy: Any GenSearch==Alice relabeling is a blocking QA defect.
requirements.claim_boundary: No consumer-Alice equivalence, citation guarantee, ranking equivalence or prevalence claim.
requirements.acceptance_check: All Step-16 outputs maintain distinct provenance.

requirements.research_statement: Every successful useful provider result needed downstream must be written to GitHub, read back and verified before analysis or the next paid provider action.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Persist complete raw result and normalized observation immediately after delivery, then read back and reconcile before next paid action.
requirements.required_artifact_field_or_output: per-interaction raw evidence + normalized observation + readback marker
requirements.cost_or_quota_boundary: next paid action blocked on persistence failure
requirements.failure_policy: STOP if GitHub write/readback or completeness QA fails.
requirements.claim_boundary: Chat/runtime/browser storage is not durable project evidence storage.
requirements.acceptance_check: No next paid action occurred before required write/readback.

requirements.research_statement: A paid question with no usable result or OUTCOME_UNKNOWN may receive up to three additional paid retries of the same question, with an explicit chat announcement before every retry.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Announce retry N/3, exact same query, reason and incremental cost; retry; stop once usable evidence is obtained.
requirements.required_artifact_field_or_output: retry_ordinal + retry_reason + provider outcome + cost accounting
requirements.cost_or_quota_boundary: max 3 additional retries after original unusable/unknown attempt; 5.08 RUB estimated per billable retry
requirements.failure_policy: After retry 3/3 fails, final case state INSUFFICIENT; no further paid replay without new owner authorization.
requirements.claim_boundary: Semantic confirmation is not the same thing as a no-result retry.

requirements.research_statement: Every selected case has pre-registered CHANGE/control-break, DE_RISK, NO_CHANGE and INSUFFICIENT conditions and requires confirmation for a material delta.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Classify each observation against its frozen per-case conditions; do not invent a post-hoc rubric after seeing the AI result.
requirements.cost_or_quota_boundary: confirmation cost only on material candidates
requirements.failure_policy: If evidence fits no pre-registered condition cleanly, use INSUFFICIENT rather than inventing a category.
requirements.claim_boundary: Step-16 classification is evidence handoff, not final architecture action.
requirements.acceptance_check: Every case maps to one governed Step-16 outcome.

requirements.research_statement: Step 16 is an evidence-acquisition stage; Step 17 owns Search-vs-AI comparison and later architecture implications.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Stop Step 16 at evidence acquisition, confirmation classification and Step-17 handoff.
requirements.failure_policy: Any automatic merge/split/create/delete/ownership rewrite in Step 16 is a process failure.
requirements.claim_boundary: AI evidence may challenge or de-risk a decision; Step 16 does not enact that change.
requirements.acceptance_check: Step-16 final artifacts contain evidence and handoff only.
